result:
All changes are in place and the full test suite (1336 tests) passes. Summary of the change implementing "Make `attrs.converters.pipe` only return a `Converter` instance if one is passed" (#1380):

- **`src/attr/_make.py`**: `pipe()` now only wraps its result in an `attrs.Converter` when at least one of the passed converters is itself a `Converter` instance; otherwise it returns a plain callable, matching the input.
- **`src/attr/converters.pyi`**: added type overloads so passing plain callables to `pipe()` types as returning a plain callable, while passing a `Converter` (or a mix) types as returning `Converter`.
- **`tests/test_converters.py`** / **`tests/test_annotations.py`**: updated cases that pass only plain callables to `pipe()` to call/inspect the returned plain function directly instead of via `.converter`, and added a test asserting `pipe()` with no `Converter` args returns a non-`Converter` callable.
- **`changelog.d/1380.change.md`**: added the changelog fragment.
